opening.text: I've had a nagging kind of headache for the past month. Recently I've been getting dizzy and feeling nauseated, but the dizziness and nausea get noticeably better when I'm outside in the cold air, though the relief is only temporary. I've been staying in a cabin for the past 5 weeks. I have high blood pressure and take amlodipine.
